lines.zh: 你看不见我，我听得见你。
lines.en: You can't see me, but I hear you.

lines.zh: 空气里有一道晃动，那就是我。
lines.en: A ripple in the air — that's me.

lines.zh: 脚步踩在地上，却不见人。
lines.en: Footfalls on the ground, no one there.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙根走，无声无息。
lines.en: I hug the wall, utterly silent.
Dust rises, with no figure to blame.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子绕了半圈。
lines.en: I trace half a circle in your shadow.
Invisible doesn't mean absent.
In the air, I quietly close in.

lines.zh: 呼吸声，是我唯一漏出的破绽。
lines.en: My breathing is the only leak.

lines.zh: 地面的草，被我踩出印子。
lines.en: The grass shows where I stepped.
You thought that was wind? It wasn't.

lines.zh: 我站着，你看不出我在哪。
lines.en: I stand here; you can't tell where.
The air is still, and so am I.

lines.zh: 没有影子，省了很多麻烦。
lines.en: No shadow — that saves trouble.
I raise a hand and wipe my face.
I've been waiting a while.
Who spoke? You misheard.
I lean on the wall, eyes closed.
I slow my breath to be harder to catch.
The dust settles again.
I shift my feet; no sound.
Even an invisible man gets bored.
Holding my breath, I count your steps.
Sunlight passes through me to the ground.

lines.zh: 别盯着某处看，会猜中的。
lines.en: Don't stare; you might guess right.

lines.zh: 我知道你看不见我，但我看着你。
lines.en: You can't see me, but I watch you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛扫过三次，都没停。
lines.en: Your eyes passed over three times.

lines.zh: 我就在你面前，一臂之遥。
lines.en: I'm right in front of you, an arm away.
Can you hear me? I speak softly.

lines.zh: 别装看不见，我知道你感觉到了。
lines.en: Don't pretend; I know you sense me.

lines.zh: 透明的人，最懂怎么盯着人。
lines.en: An invisible man knows how to stare.

lines.zh: 你这张脸，我记在空气里。
lines.en: I've stored your face in the air.
I've taken another step closer.
You shouldn't have come this way.
No shadow, but I'm here.

lines.zh: 我抬手，在你眼前晃了晃。
lines.en: I wave a hand before your eyes.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，说明有点感觉。
lines.en: You blinked — so you felt something.
Don't shout; no one will believe you.
I'm smiling; you can't see it.
One arm's length — perfect for a strike.

lines.zh: 你闻到了吗？我就在旁边。
lines.en: Do you smell it? I'm right beside you.

lines.zh: 我一直在等你自己走进来。
lines.en: I've been waiting for you to walk in.
Unseen doesn't mean unhittable.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，空气晃了一下。
lines.en: I step back; the air ripples.

lines.zh: 这一下，破了我的隐身错觉。
lines.en: That blow broke my illusion of safety.
Blood on the ground — now visible.
I clutch my ribs and pull back.
I'll remember that punch.

lines.zh: 看不见的拳头也会疼，我退开半步。
lines.en: Even invisible fists feel pain — I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我的身形晃了一下，空气里起了波纹。
lines.en: My shape wavers, ripples running through the air.

lines.zh: 我不吃那些，我吃的是气。
lines.en: I don't eat that; I feed on ki.

lines.zh: 你把东西举高，我也够不到。
lines.en: Hold it high and I still can't reach.
That bait won't move me.

lines.zh: 看不见的手，拿不到你的饵。
lines.en: Invisible hands don't take bait.

lines.zh: 我只对靠近的活物感兴趣。
lines.en: Only living things that come close interest me.

lines.zh: 你举着食物，样子很好笑。
lines.en: You holding out food looks ridiculous.

lines.zh: 我的饥饿，不是胃的饥饿。
lines.en: My hunger isn't in my stomach.
Stop waving it; I won't bite.
What I smell is your fear.

lines.zh: 你撞到我了，我就在这儿。
lines.en: You walked into me — I'm right here.
See? Invisible means collisions.
I steadied you; no thanks needed.
My body is solid enough.

lines.zh: 空气里有什么挡了你一下。
lines.en: Something in the air stopped you.
I stepped aside and you never noticed.
Don't grope about.
Now you really should be suspicious.
I make way, and you can't tell.

lines.zh: 肩膀碰了一下，仅此而已。
lines.en: A brush of shoulders, nothing more.
One of my kind? It's been long.

lines.zh: 两个透明的人，谁也看不见谁。
lines.en: Two invisible ones, neither seen.
I know you only by your breath.

lines.zh: 我们这样并肩，很像空处。
lines.en: Side by side, we look like nothing.
An invisible man's feelings are transparent too.

lines.zh: 你不必看见我，我知道你在。
lines.en: You needn't see me; I know you're there.
Don't go far; your sound fades.

lines.zh: 我们之间，只有脚印作证。
lines.en: Only footprints prove we were here.
Few in this world understand me.
Stay by me and make no sound.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，我捡起来了。
lines.en: I picked up what was on the ground.
It floats in midair — that you can see.
I only take what's useful.
Stop looking; it's in my hand.
Even a stone serves as a weapon.
I put it down and pick it up again.

lines.zh: 这东西会暴露我的位置。
lines.en: This thing gives away my position.
I toss it the other way.

lines.zh: 手里有东西，就有了重量。
lines.en: Holding something gives me weight.
Unseen, it isn't stealing.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，虽然你看不见我。
lines.en: You're marked, though you can't see me.

lines.zh: 呼吸一变，我就知道你要动。
lines.en: Your breath changed; I know you'll move.
An invisible strike is the suddenest.
I close in low to the ground.

lines.zh: 你转向哪边，我都算好了。
lines.en: Whatever way you turn, I've planned it.
I make the first move in this chase.
Stop looking; you won't find me.
Your back is to me.
Target confirmed — begin.
I quiet my breath and ready myself.
One punch away.

lines.zh: 你看不见我，沙上却多了一双脚印。
lines.en: You cannot see me, yet a new pair of prints appears in the sand.
Your heart is faster than before.
Running won't help.
I want to see how long you last.
I've been following, never stopping.

lines.zh: 这屋子里，没有你看不见的角落。
lines.en: No corner here escapes me.
You're tiring.

lines.zh: 我不急，透明的人有耐心。
lines.en: No hurry; invisible men are patient.

lines.zh: 你想从门口出去？我在那。
lines.en: The door? I'm there.
Your steps stopped; you're listening.

lines.zh: 你听不到我，但我听得到你。
lines.en: You can't hear me, but I hear you.

lines.zh: 一点一点，把你逼到墙边。
lines.en: Bit by bit, I press you to the wall.
Don't look back; I'm there too.
Your movements are slowing.
I start counting your breaths.
This game is nearly over.
I slip to your left.

lines.zh: 你还不知道自己被围着。
lines.en: You don't know you're surrounded.
One more step and I strike.
I stay silent and let you panic.

lines.zh: 天花板也在我的范围里。
lines.en: The ceiling is in my range too.
A fist comes out of empty air.
The fist you can't see hurts most.
That one caught your cheek square.

lines.zh: 我打你的腰，你弯了下去。
lines.en: I strike your side and you fold.
Stop swinging; you can't land one.
My elbow drives up.
Hear the wind? That's the blow.
I fight in close; nowhere to dodge.
A trade of blows, and I profit.
I hit your back and you pitch forward.

lines.zh: 透明的人，连拳头都不见。
lines.en: An invisible man's fist is invisible too.
I still have strength left.
That punch was a warning.

lines.zh: 你退到哪儿，我跟到哪儿。
lines.en: Wherever you retreat, I follow.
Too slow; I saw it coming.
When you fall, don't blame me.
One more person in the air.
Did you hear footsteps?
From nothing, I now stand here.
The dust takes the shape of my feet.
The invisible man arrives; don't blink.

lines.zh: 你看着我，却什么也没看到。
lines.en: You look my way and see nothing.
I raise a hand; it works.
This place feels familiar.
I arrived without disturbing anyone.

lines.zh: 一呼一吸，世界就接上我了。
lines.en: One breath and the world includes me.
First, check if anyone's around.
No shadow, but footprints.
The wind behind you suddenly stops.

lines.zh: 我站定了，接下来看你的。
lines.en: I'm in place; now it's your turn.
Don't scream; it won't help.

lines.zh: 看不见的对手，最难对付。
lines.en: An unseen foe is the hardest.
I'm here, and always was.
Flame outlines me in light.
I land hard; my feet go numb.

lines.zh: 水灌进来，隐身也没用了。
lines.en: Water pours in; invisibility is useless.

lines.zh: 箭从远处来，扎进我的肩。
lines.en: An arrow from afar lodges in my shoulder.
That ki pins me in place.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连隐身都撑不稳。
lines.en: Starving, I can't even hold my invisibility.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的轮廓全露了。
lines.en: Lightning flashes and shows my outline.

lines.zh: 脚下没地板，我整个人沉下去。
lines.en: No floor beneath me; I sink away.
